-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #1000 / Scene #13 - Function talkevent9_1
function talkevent9_1()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town000D.map")
	MoveCamera(441.00, 401.00, 83.34)
	RotCamera(5.11, 1.33, 55.00)


	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	wait(500)
	OpenTalkScene(3, 13)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(talkevent9_1)
